luciana.metaDescription: Luciana's journey: from massage and bodywork to Classical Pilates, between Buenos Aires, Portugal and Palma de Mallorca.
luciana.title: About Luciana
luciana.intro: A story of listening, learning and service through movement.
luciana.sessionImageAlt: Luciana guiding a Classical Pilates session
body: Luciana's relationship with the body began around eight years ago, through Tui-Na massage and shiatsu. That period taught her to listen with her hands and to understand that every body carries its own story.
In 2019 she met someone who taught her Pilates and opened a path that would transform her relationship with her body and with herself. What began as a practice soon became a vocation.

She continued her training through courses and workshops. In Buenos Aires she trained with Federico Randazzo of the IRPA school, who accompanied her for several years through her training and professional experience in Argentina.

In 2025 she met Miguel Silva, an instructor at the UNO Pilates school in Portugal. That encounter broadened her understanding of the body and gave greater awareness and meaning to everything that came before.
For Luciana, Pilates is a way of connecting the body from its centre out to the limbs, and of finding an inner organisation that transforms how we move, how we breathe and how we inhabit the body.

She understands teaching as a form of service: accompanying each person as they discover their body and develop a more conscious, kinder relationship with movement. And at the same time, she continues to consider herself a student.

method.metaDescription: What Classical Pilates is: the principles, the order and the original apparatus of Joseph Pilates, explained accessibly.
method.title: The Classical Pilates Method
method.intro: A complete system of movement, created by Joseph Pilates, passed on faithfully to its original order and principles.
method.imageAlt: Detail of a Classical Pilates movement

sections.title: A method with an origin
sections.text: Joseph Pilates developed his method — which he called Contrology — during the first half of the twentieth century. The classical approach preserves the repertoire, the order of the exercises and the apparatus as they were conceived, passed from teacher to student ever since.

sections.title: The principles
sections.text: Concentration, control, centre, flow, precision and breath. Six principles that turn a series of exercises into a practice of full attention: every movement has a purpose and a way of being performed.

sections.title: From the centre to the limbs
sections.text: Every movement is born from the centre of the body. By strengthening and organising that centre, the limbs move more freely, the body finds better alignment and the breath follows naturally.

sections.title: The apparatus
sections.text: The method is practised on apparatus designed by Joseph Pilates himself, such as the Reformer and the Barrel, which guide and support the body with precise springs and surfaces. At the studio we work with classical method equipment, largely by Gratz, inspired by the original designs.

sections.title: A practice for everyone
sections.text: You don't need previous experience or a particular fitness level: the method adapts to each person, and personalised attention lets you progress safely, at your own pace.

body: The studio is a space created with intention, designed so that each person can leave the everyday noise outside and dedicate time to their own wellbeing.
The views, the horizon, the natural light and the closeness of the sea accompany the practice and deepen a sense of calm and presence that is as much a part of the work as the exercises themselves.

We work with Classical Pilates Method equipment. Much of it is by Gratz, the reference brand inspired by Joseph Pilates' original designs and imported from the United States. The studio has complete method equipment, including Reformer and Barrel.
Sessions are personalised and adapt to each person's history, needs and process.

faq.metaDescription: Answers to the most common questions about Classical Pilates, the trial class, the sessions and the studio in Palma de Mallorca.
faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.intro: Everything you need to know before your first session.

items.question: What is Classical Pilates?
items.answer: It is the original method created by Joseph Pilates, passed on with its repertoire, its order and its apparatus as they were conceived. It works the body from the centre out to the limbs, guided by six principles: concentration, control, centre, flow, precision and breath.

items.question: Do I need previous experience?
items.answer: No. Sessions are personalised and fully adapt to your starting point. The trial class exists precisely to get to know your body and your moment.

items.question: Is the trial class personalised?
items.answer: Yes. It is a one-to-one session with Luciana, dedicated to assessing your posture, mobility and goals, and to letting you experience the method on the classical apparatus.

items.question: What should I wear?
items.answer: Comfortable, fitted clothing that lets the movement be seen, and socks. You don't need sports shoes: we practise barefoot or in socks.

items.question: Where is the studio located?
items.answer: The studio is in Palma de Mallorca, by the sea. When you book we'll send you the exact address and directions.

items.question: Are sessions one-to-one or duo?
items.answer: Both. You can practise one-to-one, with full attention for you, or as a duo with another person, keeping the work personalised for each body.

items.question: How long is a session?
items.answer: The exact length is confirmed when you book.

items.question: How do I find out about prices?
items.answer: The trial class costs 30 €. All other options and packs are shared privately: write to us on WhatsApp and we'll send you all the information.

items.question: How do I book my trial class?
items.answer: From the trial class page: payment is made securely online, and afterwards we arrange the day and time on WhatsApp.

items.question: How does payment work?
items.answer: Online payment is processed by Stripe, encrypted and secure, by card. We never store your card details.

items.question: Can I change or cancel a booking?
items.answer: Yes, by contacting us on WhatsApp in advance. The specific conditions for changes and cancellations are confirmed when you book.

items.question: Which apparatus is used?
items.answer: We work with classical method equipment, largely by Gratz, including Reformer and Barrel, alongside mat work.

items.question: Is it suitable if I have an injury or medical condition?
items.answer: Personalised work makes it possible to adapt the practice to many situations, but it does not replace medical care. If you have an injury or medical condition, consult a healthcare professional first and tell us before starting so we can adapt the session safely.

items.question: In which languages are sessions offered?
items.answer: Write to us on WhatsApp and we'll confirm according to your preferred language.
